title: Configure campaign playback monitoring
summary: Turn on closed-loop campaign optimisation and set the rules that classify a campaign as on rotation, mark it inactive, and retain playback records.
bodyMd:
Campaign Monitoring Settings control how the platform decides a campaign is on rotation, when it marks a campaign inactive, and how long it keeps playback analytics. These rules feed the Playback Audit column and the campaign status you see everywhere else. Allow about 3 minutes.

Before you begin

  • An HQ Admin account with the Admin role.

Steps

  1. In the left navigation, select Platform Admin.
  2. Under Enabled Features, select Campaign Monitoring Settings.
  3. Turn on Enable Closed-Loop Campaign Optimisation.
  4. Under ON ROTATION CAMPAIGN CLASSIFICATION RULES, set how many times a campaign must appear in the channel rotation, and over how many minutes, to count as on rotation.
  5. For Run the Campaign Classification, choose 24 hours a day or At a specific Daily Time.
  6. Set Update a Campaign's Status to Inactive after (in hours).
  7. Under PLAYBACK ANALYTICS RECORDS (DATA RETENTION), set Save Campaign Playback Analytics Records for Past (in days).
  8. Select Save Changes.

Settings

SettingDefaultDescription
Enable Closed-Loop Campaign OptimisationOnTurns campaign playback monitoring on or off
Campaign Appears in the Channel Rotation10 timesAppearances needed for a campaign to count as on rotation
Over the Following Duration (in minutes)60 minutesWindow in which those appearances must occur
Run the Campaign Classification24 hours a dayWhether classification runs continuously or at a set daily time
Update a Campaign's Status to Inactive after (in hours)1 hourHours without playback before a campaign is marked inactive
Save Campaign Playback Analytics Records for Past (in days)Not setHow many days of playback records the platform keeps

Verify it worked

The page reloads with your values. Within the classification window you set, the Playback Audit column in Displays & Devices shows the number of on-rotation campaigns for each online display.
